llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed workout-recording summarizer with purpose-aligned helper scripts, though users should understand when cloud transcription or the exercise dataset cache is used.

dimensions.detail: Local file inspection, ffmpeg/Whisper examples, optional cloud transcription, and a GitHub dataset lookup are proportionate to the task, but audio uploads depend on the user's chosen transcription backend.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown instructions and two Python helper scripts; no installer, autorun hook, hidden setup step, or dependency installation behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill can read user-supplied transcript/audio paths, run local helper commands, optionally use cloud transcription APIs, and use an exercise dataset; these behaviors are described in the skill and workflow, with local/default and credential-handling guardrails.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The matching helper may cache the public exercise dataset under the user's home cache directory, which is disclosed in the workflow/helper behavior and is not used to store workout transcripts or credentials.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to summarize strength-training recordings or transcripts, and the artifact's transcription guidance, duration helper, and exercise-name matching helper all support that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware that audio transcription may use a cloud provider if you choose or have credentials configured, and the exercise matcher may download/cache a public exercise dataset. Use an existing transcript, local Whisper, or pass a local dataset path if you want an offline workflow.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The file access, helper script use, and optional network transcription are coherent with summarizing local recordings/transcripts and are described with credential and local-default guardrails.
[TP4] expected: The exercise dataset matching is not a purpose mismatch: SKILL.md explicitly says to standardize exercise names against hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset, and the workflow documents dataset loading/caching.
[SDI-2] expected: The helper does fetch and cache a public GitHub JSON dataset when no local dataset is supplied; this creates a modest supply-chain/network consideration, but it is purpose-aligned, disclosed, and does not transmit workout content.
